# RawPickAI

> Independent AI tool reviews with honest scores and INR pricing. As featured in The Epoch Times, ZeroHedge, and Gulf Insider.

RawPickAI is an independent AI tool review site. Every tool is tested by hand before being reviewed. We score tools on 5 criteria: Ease of Use, Output Quality, Value for Money, Feature Depth, and Free Tier.

## Key Facts
- 50+ AI tools reviewed with hands-on testing
- 21 head-to-head comparisons tested with identical prompts
- 9 best-of ranking lists based on real benchmarks
- Pricing shown in both USD and INR (at ₹93/USD)
- No sponsored rankings — affiliate links disclosed separately
- Daily news updates, weekly roundups
- As featured in The Epoch Times, ZeroHedge, Gulf Insider

## Content Types

### Reviews
Individual tool reviews at rawpickai.com/review/[tool-name]
Each review includes: scores out of 5, pricing breakdown in USD and INR, pros/cons, verdict, and who it's best for.

### Comparisons
Side-by-side comparisons at rawpickai.com/comparisons/[tool-vs-tool] and rawpickai.com/blog/[tool-vs-tool]
Each comparison tests both tools on identical tasks with scoring.

### Studies
Data-driven research at rawpickai.com/studies/
The 2026 AI Tools Reality Check: 48 tools analyzed, downloadable CSV (CC BY 4.0). Key findings: 79% hide enterprise pricing, $16-30/mo sweet spot, only 4 tools scored above 4.5/5.

### Interactive Tools
- Transparency Index: rawpickai.com/tools/transparency-index — 50 tools rated on pricing honesty
- Compare Tool: rawpickai.com/tools/compare — side-by-side comparison builder
- Free Tier Comparison: rawpickai.com/tools/free-tier-comparison — every free plan ranked
- Pricing Calculator: rawpickai.com/tools/pricing-calculator — estimate costs in USD and INR
- Quiz: rawpickai.com/tools/quiz — find the right AI tool for your workflow

### News
Daily AI news briefs at rawpickai.com/news/[slug]
Weekly roundups at rawpickai.com/blog/ai-tool-news-roundup-[date]
